## Change and reader value

Describe the addition or correction, its primary source, and what readers gain.
For a new work, explain its distinct contribution, closest related work and a meaningful limitation.
For a correction, identify the affected claim and supporting source section/version.

## Content checks

- [ ] I checked titles, authors, identifiers and dates against primary sources.
- [ ] Each new work has one chronological record and a relevant topic entry; alternate URLs and cross-lists do not create duplicates.
- [ ] Descriptions distinguish reported results from general claims and scope metrics to the evaluated setup.
- [ ] Local links, anchors and affected counts are consistent.
- [ ] Corrections reach every affected occurrence, including README, Hall and summaries where applicable.
- [ ] Proposed Hall membership or README selections are identified separately for editorial review.

Code/data links are welcome when available. New detailed summaries are optional and should be clearly identified in the change description.
